history.entities_raw: United Nations Assistance Mission in Somalia
history.sg_progress: The observed excess over the standard vehicle ratio was due to the Mission operating in five independent sectors, some in areas of active combat. No new vehicle acquisitions were budgeted for UNSOM in the 2021 and 2022 budgets cycles. The Mission has implemented the audit recommendations to redeploy light passenger vehicles for improved utilization through the Vehicle Establishment Committee. With regard to VIP armoured vehicles, the Close Protection Unit supports four principals in the mission area. The removal of any vehicle will have a negative impact on the operational capability of the Unit and its ability to provide the required support to senior leadership. The Administration requests the closure of this recommendation by the Board.
